text:
When a source of D-particles is directed towards a thin metal foil they become scattered.
Which observation of this experiment provides evidence for a small charged nucleus?
A small proportion of the D-particles come straight back from the foil towards the source.
A
A small proportion of the D-particles pass straight through the foil.
B
Some of the D-particles are deflected by an angle of less than 90°.
C
Some of the D-particles follow a curved path after leaving the foil.
D

options.label: A
options.text: A small proportion of the D-particles come straight back from the foil towards the source.

options.label: B
options.text: A small proportion of the D-particles pass straight through the foil.

options.label: C
options.text: Some of the D-particles are deflected by an angle of less than 90°.

options.label: D
options.text: Some of the D-particles follow a curved path after leaving the foil.
